title: ISO Hub — Cover
description: Title slide introducing ISO Hub as Indonesia's leading ISO compliance platform.
speakerNotes:
Open by positioning ISO Hub as Indonesia's ISO compliance platform.

- AI-powered document generation
- Risk management
- Audit tracking
- Built for Indonesian organizations

Introduce the nine-plus supported standards before moving into the problem.

title: The Problem
description: Three core pain points companies face with ISO certification today.
speakerNotes:
Frame the three barriers companies face today.

- Certification can take 12–36 months
- Experienced consultants are difficult to find and price transparency is limited
- Thousands of pages are created and revised manually

Use this slide to establish urgency before presenting the solution.

title: The Solution
description: ISO Hub's three-pillar platform approach: AI, verified consultants, and management tools.
speakerNotes:
Explain the three pillars of ISO Hub.

- Specialist AI agents for gap analysis, documents, and audit preparation
- Verified consultants for human support
- Integrated management tools for the full compliance workflow

The key message is one platform from gap analysis to audit-ready documents.

title: AI Agents
description: Five specialist AI agents covering every aspect of ISO certification.
speakerNotes:
Introduce the five specialist agents: ISO, Legal, Technical, Audit, and Training.

- Each agent focuses on a distinct part of the certification journey
- OPC CLAW coordinates them so complex ISO work can happen in parallel
- The result is faster, more focused support across standards, regulations, documents, audits, and training

title: Risk Management & Audit
description: Integrated risk management and audit tracking capabilities.
speakerNotes:
Show how ISO Hub connects operational risk work with certification readiness.

- Interactive ISO 31000 risk matrix
- Incident, vendor, KPI, and mitigation tracking
- Audit scheduling, findings, corrective actions, and gap analysis
- A visual path from preparation to certification

title: OPC CLAW Orchestration
description: Multi-agent orchestration system for parallel ISO task execution.
speakerNotes:
Walk through the orchestration flow.

- A user submits an ISO task
- OPC CLAW decomposes it into optimal sub-tasks
- Five agents execute in parallel
- Results are compiled into one complete solution

The slide highlights five active agents, 24/7 availability, and a response time under two seconds.

title: Supported Standards
description: Nine-plus ISO standards supported on one unified platform.
speakerNotes:
Emphasize the breadth of standards supported on one platform.

- ISO 9001, 14001, and 45001
- ISO 27001, 37001, and 31000
- IATF 16949, ISO 22000, and ISO 50001

The platform combines AI guidance and document templates for Indonesian industries.

title: Platform at a Glance
description: Key platform metrics and traction indicators.

- 50+ verified facilitators
- 9+ supported ISO standards
- 100+ free articles and guides
- 20+ integrated modules

Together they represent human support, standards coverage, practical knowledge, and end-to-end tools.

title: Market Opportunity
description: Indonesia's ISO certification market and key growth drivers.
speakerNotes:

- ISO certification is increasingly important for government tenders and exports
- Millions of Indonesian SMEs are pursuing stronger global competitiveness
- Industry is ready to adopt AI for operational efficiency and compliance

Close with ISO Hub's differentiation: transparent entry pricing, Indonesian context, AI plus humans, end-to-end coverage, and broad standards support.
